title: A Full Coolant Tank Does Not Prove Winter Protection
topic: Coolant level does not establish coolant concentration or freeze protection
mechanicTruth: Coolant level and coolant freeze protection are different measurements; winter readiness depends on the correct coolant chemistry and concentration for the vehicle, not merely a full reservoir.
